name: AI-Generated Stock Music / Licensing

yield.notes: Per-track royalties very low ($0.02-$2). Requires large catalog. Licensing deals more lucrative but harder to land.

flags: AI music copyright ownership legally contested
Streaming platforms may restrict AI music (Spotify policy changes)
Suno/Udio terms of service regarding commercial licensing

prerequisites: Suno.ai, Udio, or Mubert account ($0-$30/mo depending on commercial tier)
startup_checklist: Choose target market: YouTube creators, ad agencies, podcasters, game developers
Generate 50+ tracks in commercially useful genres (background, lo-fi, corporate)
Upload to Pond5, AudioJungle, or Artlist
Review AI copyright policy on each platform before uploading
Build catalog to 200+ tracks for meaningful passive income
failure_modes: Platform bans AI music mid-catalog build
Market oversaturated before catalog is built
sources_note: Royalty rates from stock music platform published payout data.
